notes: Source: NovaStar official "VX4S-N All-in-One Controller Specifications V1.0.1" PDF (oss.novastar.tech). This is an LED display controller/video processor (categorized here as Converter/video processor since "LED controller" isn't in the provided type list). Rear panel has two BNC-style connectors for SDI IN+LOOP (2 physical jacks, 1 logical bidirectional port used as in+loop-through) - modeled as a single sdi-3g port with note. DVI input also has IN+LOOP (2 physical BNC/DVI jacks) - modeled similarly as one input port. Power connector confirmed as standard IEC inlet (100-240V~ 50/60Hz 1.5A, 25W) from rear-panel photo; exact IEC sub-type (C13/C14) not explicitly labeled in text so assumed standard IEC (C13/C14) grade omitted since power ports don't carry a grade. Audio input is a single 3.5mm-style "AUDIO" connector per rear panel photo and retailer listings (some distributor pages describe it as 1/8" (3.5mm) audio input). USB Type-B (front panel) connects to control PC; USB Type-A and a separate rear USB Type-B are for linking additional units (device chaining) - both included. No HDMI/DP/DVI version-specific bandwidth grade beyond what's stated (HDMI 1.3, DP with HDCP 1.3, DVI single-link) was given as a formal "grade" spec in the graded scale sense beyond hdmi-1.4 minimum tier, so grade omitted for HDMI/DP/DVI since the connector's actual spec (HDMI 1.3) is below the lowest allowed enum value (hdmi-1.4) - only SDI and Ethernet grades set since those map cleanly to the provided enums (sdi-3g, eth-1g). Not rack-ear-mounted per photos but is standard 19" wide 1U chassis (482.6mm W x 250mm D x 50mm H) - set rackUnits=1.

ports.name: 3G-SDI IN+LOOP
ports.note: Two BNC jacks (IN + LOOP-through); loop output passes the same signal. Max 1920x1080@60Hz, supports ST-424 (3G) and ST-292 (HD).

ports.name: DVI IN+LOOP
ports.note: Two DVI jacks (IN + LOOP-through). VESA standard, up to 1920x1200@60Hz, HDCP 1.4, single-link

ports.name: HDMI 1.3
ports.note: HDMI version 1.3, up to 1920x1200@60Hz input, HDCP 1.4 compliant. Below lowest gradable enum (hdmi-1.4) so grade omitted.

ports.name: DP
ports.note: Up to 1920x1200@60Hz input, HDCP 1.3 compliant. Version not specified beyond DisplayPort generic, so grade omitted.

ports.name: Ethernet 1
ports.note: Gigabit Ethernet output for LED panel data; also doubles as audio output when multifunction card used

ports.name: DVI OUT
ports.note: Monitor/loop output for previewing output image

ports.name: ETHERNET
ports.note: Control port: connects to control PC and/or network

ports.name: USB (Type-B)
ports.note: Front panel; connects to control PC for device control

ports.name: USB (Type-B)
ports.note: Rear panel control section; input connector to link another device

ports.name: USB (Type-A)
ports.note: Rear panel; output connector to link another device

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: 100-240V~, 50/60Hz, 1.5A, 25W max consumption; standard IEC inlet shown on rear panel
